g.text: Monorepo — workspace ownership before checkout and subscription
For /v1 or /chess resolve tenant
Private no-store for authenticated tenants and auth/account routes
409 workspace_changed
yes
Browser expected-workspace header differs outside auth/admin/operator?
Continue
yes
Not authenticated browser/key/dev billing route, or webhook/operator?
For quote GET require quote tenant equals resolved tenant; otherwise 404
Limit/buffer body to 1 MiB; require object
Reject duplicate case-insensitive identity fields when read
Supplied nonblank tenant must equal resolved tenant
Key redemption requires checkout session owned by tenant
Preflight for subscription service requires integer units = 1
Rewind request body even on parsing failure
yes
JSON POST?
Browser requires workspace owner/admin
Require Stripe key and, in identity mode, PostgreSQL billing storage
Live Stripe keys require commercial catalog approval
Read existing tenant entitlements
409 subscription_already_exists
yes
Existing subscription has active/trialing/past_due/unpaid/incomplete/paused status?
yes
Subscription purchase?
Continue to billing endpoint
Source-reviewed orchestration. Nested semantics remain open; no runtime acceptance
claimed. Complete ownership middleware reviewed. It validates request ownership and
selected subscription prerequisites; it does not itself charge, grant entitlement or
reserve a unique subscription transaction. Duplicate-property detection applies only to
queried identity fields. Existing-subscription read and downstream purchase are separate
operations. Billing enforcement bypass is a different option whose default is true in
AppComposition.
